title: Switch production build to Preact
body:
Preact a lightweight implementation of React. This could help create a lighter build for instantsearch.js.
- [ ] POC
- [ ] Create the new build

comments.body: What's the difference? What is removed from React in Preact that we don't use?

> What's the difference?

One is: React=80KB gziped VS Preact=3KB gziped :)

The difference doesn't seem to big. It removes synthetic events and proptypes amongst others things. Truth is, we don't know if it's for us, but we should give it a try and see if we should switch, propose an alternative build or even not use it :)

> What's the difference? What is removed from React in Preact that we don't use?

There's a good explanation: https://preactjs.com/guide/differences-to-react

Thruth is that we chose React without worrying about the filesize first but it does WEIGH a lot (not 80kb gzipped still).

We had multiple users reporting filesize as an issue.

When we target "vanilla JS" developers then inlining REACT inside our library can be seen like inlining prototype.js inside a jQuery plugin.

I'm all for trimming down the huge filesize. If going to Preact reduces the filesize that much, we definitely need to try a POC. In the end I'd like to have an instantsearch.js v2 that is not so tightly tied to React, but in the short term if we can address the main issue of the filesize with such a quick win, I'm all for it :)

> In the end I'd like to have an instantsearch.js v2 that is not so tightly tied to React

:+1: we can discuss that in our next week meeting
